Вывод: Picasso supports PMCx02B (LsSmiRx); direct per-CPU SMI counts can complement hardware latency sampling.
Доказательство: AMD OSRR 56255 rev3.03 July 2018 p153, family17h models00h–2Fh: PMCx02B counts received SMIs, unit mask reserved. https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/processor-tech-docs/programmer-references/56255_OSRR.pdf ; kernel hwlat documentation https://docs.kernel.org/trace/hwlat_detector.html .
